name: ruang-temu-root
description: Integrated Cafe Management System (POS, Kitchen/Bar Checker, CRM, Inventory & Backoffice) for RUANG TEMU

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
